backtest.method: Formal accuracy uses predictions preserved at least five minutes before kickoff; CLV remains unavailable until a price is captured inside the closing window.

public_reference_gate.policy: Keep probabilities visible, but do not emit a directional public lean for markets that fail locked-sample validation.

notes: No sample is counted unless the prediction was locked before kickoff.
CLV is only calculated against a snapshot captured inside the configured closing window.

model_comparison.promotion_rule: Promote only when the candidate lowers both log-loss and Brier on at least 40 settled samples.

factor_gate.policy: Only backtested factors can raise core model weight; proxy factors stay display-only or receive a confidence penalty.
